data.long_meaning: A person who is deeply engaged in the remembrance of Allah, striving to fulfill their duties towards Him. This name is derived from the Arabic root ‘dhakara’ which means ‘to remember’. The name Dhaakirah carries the meaning “Rememberer of the Almighty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dhaakirah usually hope their child will grow to embody rememberer of the almighty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
